verdict.rationale: Twilio documents Console-based submission of toll-free numbers for messaging verification, with the ability to review verification status, which covers the guided submission and visible status parts of the story. Nothing in the pack shows Twilio stating that texting stays blocked until approval; the community reports about registration demands concern 10DLC and business paperwork, not toll-free gating. Missing for 10: documented statement that toll-free texting is blocked until approval, detail on the guided submission flow and status states, independent hands-on corroboration of the toll-free verification experience.
